decisions.reason: The multi-model LED track spotlight line, launched in 2023 with its own page, is central to the firm's modular system offer, so the investment and public commitment favour keeping it.
Launched only in 2024 as a multi-model line with its own presentation page and close to the core offer, so any weak early results can still be put down to the launch phase.
The multi-outlet canopy builds on the established system and is visibly presented on its own page, which supports the firm's flexible-system positioning and justifies persisting.
The low-voltage canopy complements the modular low-voltage offer and was launched only in 2024 with its own page, so commitment and the short time on the market favour keeping it.

The round glass track luminaire line is close to the core track offer, but it is only mentioned on the website, a less visible commitment, so it carries somewhat higher risk while still being kept as a recent multi-model launch.
